policy.auto_update: only_update_local_open_components; never submit credentials or install paid/SaaS tools without explicit user confirmation
policy.privacy: Do not send store names, cookies, screenshots, or seller data to external tools unless the user explicitly asks and the tool/account boundary is clear.

tools.name: LinkFox Skills
tools.watch: Cross-border ecommerce skill catalog and install commands.
tools.adoption: Use as optional skill source only. Do not bundle third-party skills into ziniao-ops without license and security review.

tools.name: LinkFox Agent
tools.watch: Market research, competitor analysis and report generation features.
tools.adoption: Route users to this tool for external market/competitor research. Do not make it a default dependency for local Ziniao store opening.

tools.name: LinkFox AI
tools.watch: Product image, main-image and video generation workflow support.
tools.adoption: Recommend for creative asset work. Keep outside default employee-local Ziniao automation.

tools.name: Self Improving Agent
tools.watch: Task reflection, error recording and reusable learning patterns.
tools.adoption: Adopt the idea through local, privacy-safe logs in ziniao-ops. Do not send seller data to an external memory tool by default.

tools.name: Amazon Reviews
tools.watch: Amazon review scraping, filtering, sentiment and product-improvement insights.
tools.adoption: Useful for Amazon research workflows, not for opening Ziniao seller stores.

tools.name: Seller Sprite
tools.watch: Amazon product research, keyword research, pricing, ads, profit and MCP/API changes.
tools.adoption: Optional upstream for Amazon research. Require explicit user API/MCP setup before use.
